'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hi brother, how are you? At least you're in good health, that's what's really important. Besides the gear, my customers are taking interest in diesel fuel and all that stuff. Can you bring a few cans of fuel conditioners? They are usually used to improve the quality of fuel for the portable generators. I already have the buyers ready to take it off our hands immediately. I need new unused ones, so look for them yourself. See you around, brother.}}

==Requirements== 
* Must be level 23 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 4 [[Fuel conditioner|Fuel conditioners]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 4 [[Fuel conditioner|Fuel conditioners]] to [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +14,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 20,000 Roubles
** 21,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 23,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[HighCom Striker ACHHC IIIA helmet (Black)]]
* 1× [[NPP KlASS Korund-VM body armor (Black)]]
* Unlocks craft for [[Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (MultiCam)]] at [[Hideout#modules|Lavatory level 2]]
{{quote|Oh, cool, give 'em here. Mechanic asked for it, as you've probably figured. I'll send it to him today. Thank you, big help.}}
